description: Learning Python and OVOS Skill development.  This is a simple OVOS Skill that runs a few Raspberry PI system commands and reports on the heath of the system - initially Temp, CPU load, Disk usage and throttling history. It is also contains a few python/skill development tests (a playland for me) - WHAT:  WhatAreYouDoing (intent & dialog) - WHO DA MAN:  Intent and dialog
